title: Yes, Rueben Bain Jr.'s arms are short by NFL standards. Here's why it doesn't really matter

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Yes, Rueben Bain Jr.'s arms are short by NFL standards. Here's why it doesn't really matter
sources.description: Lots of people have noted that Miami's star edge rusher has short arms. But nobody has engaged the point beyond that — and when you do, you realize he already has answers to mitigate the issue.
